title: Clean DCP Coordinate Rounding: Exact Coverage Identities and No-Overflow Countercontrols

theorems.statement: For any A in Z_{2^t}^{n x K} with an odd-determinant n x n pivot block and any full-rank basis B_red in Z^{K x K} of the q-ary kernel lattice Lambda_q(A) = {z in Z^K : A z = 0 mod 2^t} (det = 2^{nt}), the half-open fundamental parallelepiped P_c(B_red) = c + B_red[-1/2, 1/2)^K centered at c = (1/2, ..., 1/2)^T contains uniquely one integer point z_Babai(t) per target coset t in Z_{2^t}^n, and |{t in Z_{2^t}^n : z_Babai(t) in {0,1}^K}| == |{0,1}^K intersect P_c(B_red)|.

For every target t in Z_{2^t}^n, the centered residual e(t) = z_Babai(t) - c lies in (Z + 1/2)^K, so z_Babai(t) in {0,1}^K iff ||e(t)||_infinity == 1/2, and z_Babai(t) notin {0,1}^K iff ||e(t)||_infinity >= 3/2.

When U_t|0> = |z_Babai(t)> is plugged into dcp_direct_witness_filter and dcp_forward_sampler_swap on K = nt + Delta clean phase qubits, verified coverage is beta_Babai(A) = |{0,1}^K intersect P_c(B_LLL)| / 2^{nt}, direct-filter full-secret success is 2^{-Delta} beta_Babai(A)^2, and forward-SWAP parity advantage is |{t in Z_{2^t}^n : ||e(t)||_inf == 1/2 and ||e((t+h) mod 2^t)||_inf == 1/2}| / (2 * 2^K).
